facts.text: I am planning a birthday party for my mom's 60th birthday.
I need ideas for a theme and decorations for my mom's 60th birthday party.
I want to incorporate my mom's gardening hobby into the party with a garden party theme.
I want to incorporate my mom's friends from her gardening club into the party.
I was thinking of having the gardening club members help with the decorations and setup beforehand.
I want the gardening club members to feel more involved.
I want to show my appreciation for their friendship and support.
I was thinking of having the gardening club members help with flower arrangements and setting up the "garden" area.
I was thinking of having the gardening club members help with preparing some garden-themed food and drinks.
I think I will ask the gardening club members to help with setting up a "memory lane" area with photos of my mom's gardening journey.
I think the gardening club members might have great ideas for how to display the photos and make the memory lane area special.
